newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar firms on forex sales in slow mkt.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar firms on forex sales in slow mkt.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 472.00/473.00 per dollar Friday, compared to 472.50/473.50 per dollar Thursday, on currency sales by both individuals and the Central Bank, traders said.
Traders stressed, however, that trading levels were thin.
"The market was dead. Demand for currency was very scarce so supply dominated," one trader said.
"In addition the Central Bank intervened in the morning and managed to bring down the rate by one (bolivar)," he added.
